title: FermatQuinticJacobian: Lean 4 Certificate for the Jacobian Smoothness of the Fermat Quintic Fourfold
description: Standalone Lean 4 formalization (`FermatQuinticJacobian.lean`) certifying the non-degeneracy of the partial derivatives and Jacobian smoothness criterion for the Fermat quintic fourfold V(x_0^5 + ... + x_5^5) subset P^5. Certifies Jacobian smoothness of the Fermat quintic host variety in Lean 4. Explicitly states that Jacobian smoothness is a prerequisite geometric property and not a resolution of the Hodge Conjecture. Copyright (c) 2026 Benjamin Stanley Frohman.
